label: July 27 – August 2, 2026
intro: A holiday week! Asalha Bucha (Wed) and Khao Phansa (Thu) mean days off and candlelit temples.

activities.title: Asalha Bucha at Wat Pho or Wat Arun
activities.why: A day off school and work! Big temples hold beautiful ceremonies — evening candlelight processions are genuinely magical for a 5-year-old. Cross the river by boat for bonus adventure points.
activities.tip: Khao Phansa (Buddhist Lent) starts Thursday July 30 — some venues run holiday hours all week.

activities.title: Holiday-Week Workshop Day
activities.why: Two weekday holidays = prime time for a chocolate-making or pottery session without taking time off. Book early — holiday slots fill fast.
